caption: The drawing depicts a wooden wall shelf with a total of eight rectangular compartments of varying sizes, separated by vertical and horizontal dividers. The shelf is primarily brown, with wood grain texture visible throughout the structure. At the top of the shelf, there is an ornate, carved crest featuring a symmetrical floral or botanical design. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or beige color, with no additional objects or decorations. The artist's signature, "ETHEL DOUGAN 1938," is written in the lower right corner of the image. The overall composition centers the shelf, showing it fully front-on, with clear detailing of the woodwork and the carved upper section.
title: Hand Carved Cabinet
